resources.string: Your donations help me maintain my projects.\n\nTap on the button below to visit my donation page. If your watch has a browser, it may open in the watch browser.

To import logins from a file, push your unencrypted JSON export to the Download folder:

adb push export.json /sdcard/Download/

Then tap "Pick file" below.

The following services are currently supported:
⋅ Aegis Authenticator
⋅ Bitwarden 
⋅ AndOTP
